author: PoutyJinx
name: SinPurge
short: Purge recent messages from a specific user.
description: SIN Corporation moderation tool for Red-DiscordBot. Purge recent messages from a user across one or all channels, including voice-channel chats, banned or left users, and automatic 5-minute timeout for current members.
install_msg: SIN Purge installed. Use `[p]sinpurge @user 1h`, `[p]sinpurge USER_ID 1h all`, or `/sinpurge`. Current members are automatically timed out for 5 minutes when permissions allow.
